evidence.reason: The current tip's AcceptancePayloadSchema already encodes the alleged missing coupling: after `.strict()` it applies `.refine((payload) => !payload.independent || payload.reviewerId !== payload.authorId, ...)`, rejecting author self-closure reported as independent. This refinement appears in commit 754242e4b238c0c2986980e894fa85ad5b30691d ("fix(review): encode v3 journal couplings and widen persisted result types"), which is the fixing change. The finding's claim that the schema has no refinement is therefore no longer true of the current code.
